title: Rivals of Ixalan: card flavor text

entities.name: Caparocti Sunborn
entities.description: A Sun Empire speaker who invokes the sun's light and creation.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior who praises champions, dinosaurs and Tilonalli's gifts, and speaks to Tishana of working together.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A vampire conqueror called the Butcher of Magan.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A figure who commands stillness.

entities.name: Itzama the Crested
entities.description: A speaker who tells how Kinjalli sculpted humans from clay and dinosaurs from stone.

entities.name: Mahuiz
entities.description: A Sun Empire archer who speaks of pterodons.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who plunged into his past and recovered shards of memory in the great sphinx's chamber.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A River Heralds figure who counsels progress without splashes and to whom Huatli speaks.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk who controlled the Immortal Sun, making the rapids rise.

entities.name: Udvil Ratlock
entities.description: A speaker nicknamed Ratty who taunts a vampire.

entities.name: Queen Miralda the Pious
entities.description: The queen of the Legion of Dusk's vampires, whose conquistadors are never slain.

entities.name: Onora
entities.description: A figure who knew he would never see the Great River again.

entities.name: Gurezan
entities.description: A Legion resurrectionist who speaks of no more fear of death.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who leads the Brazen Coalition and speaks of its use of goblins.

entities.name: Captain Brandis Thorn
entities.description: A pirate captain who warns of regisaurs and raptors.

entities.name: Daphne Vail
entities.description: The first mate of the Diremore.

entities.name: Yacha
entities.description: An Otepec huntmaster who armors ferocidons.

entities.name: Captain Lannery Storm
entities.description: A pirate captain who sails for riches and adventure.

entities.name: Brint Doobin
entities.description: A pirate whose last words warned of a death lizard.

entities.name: Sisora
entities.description: A hero who defeated the tyrant of Azcanta and wore a jade piece.

entities.name: Natena of Vuhana
entities.description: A leader of a band before Sisora.

entities.name: Atiuru
aliases: Atiuru, priest of the Verdant Sun
entities.description: A priest of the Verdant Sun.

entities.name: Nirit of Pashona
entities.description: A member of Pashona's band who speaks of mist.

entities.name: Pashona
entities.description: A shaper whose band includes Nirit.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker pirate who values freedom and seeks the burning of the enemy fleet.

entities.name: Captain Brinely Rage
entities.description: A pirate captain who comments on a strider harness.

entities.name: Boyl Bucksalt
entities.description: A Storm Fleet swab.

entities.name: Mavren
entities.description: A vampire who sought a savior.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: A vampire, the Dusk Rose, whose centuries-long search is ended.

entities.name: Hadana
entities.description: A figure who seeks power in the service of peace.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker captain whose conquistador followed power.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: A sun god who sculpted humans from clay.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A sun god whose gifts make the smallest great.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: The Verdant Sun god, whom Atiuru serves as priest.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that is a source of eternal life to the Legion of Dusk, a symbol of identity to the Sun Empire and a terror to the River Heralds.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire army that sailed from Torrezon seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire church of Torrezon.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A realm that bends nature, including dinosaurs, to its will and considers the Immortal Sun its identity.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who fought three enemy forces and fear the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate alliance that covets the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Storm Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet.

entities.name: Deeproot
entities.description: The jungle people who resist invaders.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: A Sun Empire group led by huntmasters.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire homeland from which the Legion sailed.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city whose opening unleashed horrors.

entities.name: Great River
entities.description: The river the River Heralds protect.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A floating pirate city.

entities.name: Azcanta
entities.description: A city whose tyrant Sisora defeated.

entities.name: Leor
entities.description: A port obscured by fog.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the story.

entities.name: Grim Captain
entities.description: A figure whose lure of undeath a gravestone is made to silence.

events.summary: Jace tumbles down a waterfall and plunges deep into his past.
events.quote: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

events.summary: The struggle for control of the Immortal Sun darkens the world under a blood-red sky.
events.quote: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

events.summary: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rise and the waterfalls take flight.
events.quote: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rose from their riverbeds and the waterfalls took flight.

events.summary: Legion explorers reach Orazca and ransack tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Jace sees the great sphinx's chamber and his memories begin to return.
events.quote: As soon as Jace laid eyes on the great sphinx's chamber, the shards of memory began sliding into place.

events.summary: The opening of Orazca unleashes horrors beyond the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: When the golden city opens, the dinosaurs inside greet the new visitors.
events.quote: When the golden city opened, the dinosaurs inside were eager to greet the new visitors.

events.summary: The River Heralds fight a running battle against the three enemy forces.
events.quote: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

events.summary: Onora realizes he will never see the Great River again.
events.quote: Onora knew with sudden, grim certainty he would never see the Great River again.

events.summary: A vampire conquistador abandons queen and church to follow power.
events.quote: Abandoning both queen and church, he chose to follow power.

events.summary: The contenders for Orazca find that others have already staked a claim.
events.quote: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

events.summary: In the galleon's wreckage the conquistadors swear vows of revenge.
events.quote: In its wreckage, they swore vows of revenge.

Miralda says her conquistadors are never slain
relations.quote: My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest.

relations.quote: The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies.
